finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Accept either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is now `undefined`, not `false` | Treat unset as off |

The 8 remaining lines are deprecation warnings. They are noise, but `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is flagged for removal before v5. Worth a look later.
